metadata.title: कोकबोरोक भाषा दिवस: आदिवासी भाषा का उत्सव और स्क्रिप्ट का संकट | Kokborak Tribal Language Day
metadata.description: A colourful rally of tribal students, intellectuals, poets and authors today marched through the Agartala to commemorate the day of 19th January when the then left front government had by an official notification had recognized tribal ‘Kokborok’ as one of the official languages of the state in the year 1979. The students, intellectuals , poets and authors and a gathering of common tribal people had assembled in front of the Rabindra Shata Varshiki Bhawan and from there marched through the thoroughfares in the town before gathering in front of Rabindra Shata Varshiki Bhawan. on this occasion we bring you a special report from Agartala, Tripura.
